This '''[[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commando]]''' was one of the [[Senate Guard/Legends|guards]] assigned to protect [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] during a [[Alderaan Conference on the Clone War Refugee Crisis|conference]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. He patrolled the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Royal Palace's]] air vents in search of a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]], but found no signs of intrusion. He contacted [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]], the head of Amidala's security detail, to inform him that the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] hadn't yet been discovered.
